about: Tags for African Leadership Academy that OpenStreetMap does not have yet, from ALA's campus photos: dark green metal roofs, walls of red face brick or white plaster, two storeys, a red face-brick boundary wall (Street View, Printech Ave). Which building is brick and which is white is a guess: change building:material to brick or plaster to match the real campus. Use it with: python place2mc.py --center -26.07538,27.91607 --radius 400 --tags examples/ala/ala-tags.json
